description: Studio's words for the platform's transaction states, step statuses, WV-TXN codes and incident resolutions. tests/unit/test_transaction_corpus.py checks the keys against the platform (TRANSACTION_STATES, PARTICIPANT_STATUSES, TRANSACTION_MESSAGES and IncidentResolution's kinds); studio/tests/transaction-words.test.ts checks Studio's words against these. A state's facts are what its frame badge also reads; a pending step shows no word.

deciding.badge: Waiting for submit, which can't be undone

codes.WV-TXN-UNDO-STUCK: A step's undo couldn't finish, so the transaction is in doubt.
codes.WV-TXN-CANCEL-STUCK: A reservation couldn't be released, so the transaction is in doubt.
codes.WV-TXN-CONFIRM-STUCK: A reservation couldn't be confirmed after the transaction went ahead.
codes.WV-TXN-AFTER-PIVOT-STUCK: A step after the point of no return couldn't finish.
codes.WV-TXN-PIVOT-UNKNOWN: The step that can't be undone may or may not have happened.
codes.WV-TXN-SETTLE-TIMEOUT: Steps still running didn't finish in time, so nothing can be undone safely yet.
codes.WV-TXN-HOLD-INSUFFICIENT: Reservations wouldn't outlast the step that can't be undone, so the transaction was undone first.
codes.WV-TXN-HOLD-EXPIRED: Reservations were about to expire before the transaction could finish.
codes.WV-TXN-RUN-CANCELLED: The run was canceled, so the transaction was undone.
codes.WV-TXN-RUN-TIMED-OUT: The run timed out, so the transaction was undone.
codes.WV-TXN-RUN-OVERSIZED: The run grew too large to undo its transactions, so they're held until someone force cancels the run.
codes.WV-TXN-UNDO-PINNED: A transaction that is still running may need this activation to undo a step.
codes.WV-TXN-RECONCILE-DENIED: This run isn't allowed to resolve the transaction.

retry.label: Retry the undo
retry.help: Runs the undo again with the same operation key. Only if the other system can take it again.

wait_again.label: Wait again
wait_again.help: Waits again for the steps still running, up to the same limit.

mark_reconciled.label: Mark as reconciled
mark_reconciled.help: You checked every step in the other systems. Say how the transaction ended.

it_happened.label: It happened
it_happened.help: The step that can't be undone did happen. The transaction finishes and its later steps run.

it_didnt_happen.label: It didn't happen
it_didnt_happen.help: The step that can't be undone didn't happen. Weave undoes what was done.

force_end.label: Force end
force_end.help: Ends the transaction and the run as they are. Nothing more is done or undone.
